liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Green Onions** (1 review, 2 other sources): Reviewer was dancing near the stage, burning, as this song started; Uploader notes it as the only time the band played it [3][4][19]
- **Box of Rain** (2 reviews): Phil noticed a woman on her boyfriend's shoulders, then counted the band into the opener; Phil sings it; reviewer finds it soft-rock in feel, but Jerry enunciates it well [22][27]
- **I Know You Rider** (2 reviews): Reviewer rates the China-Rider among the best ever, citing Phil and a long jam leading into Rider; Jerry sings with heartfelt emotion on the 'headlight' line [20][25]
- **Cold Rain and Snow** (1 review): Audience moaning along with Jerry on 'snow' is audible on the recording [27]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (1 other source): Jerry teases Deal before this song [1]
- **Believe It Or Not** (1 review): Reviewer was moved to tears by this song [18]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer finds it soulful, with Jerry clearly feeling it [25]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls it wild [26]

## Setlist highlights

- **Green Onions**: back after 226 archived shows (1166 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [28]
- **Believe It Or Not**: rare: 9 archived performances [28]
- **Mickey Space**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-06-30.akg460.ackerman.andrewf.81533.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-06-30.sbd.miller.96071.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 161 min; rated 3.9/5 by 20 [2]
- **gd1988-06-30.145661.fob.akg460.ackerman.noel.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 157 min [3]
- **gd1988-06-30.144572.FOB.AKG.Kyocera-Remaster.Ackerman.Noel.t-flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 157 min [4]
- **gd88-06-30.schoeps-fob.gustin.414.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 23 songs; 163 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [9]. Said about its sound: Full-show file sounds really good, far better than the reviewer's 17-year-old tape [18]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's shirt caught fire from a cigarette near the stage just before Green Onions; a friend doused it with beer [19]
- Band seemed to enjoy the baseball stadium's sound; this was their second year playing Rochester [20]
- Tickets were general admission at a AAA ballpark; cloudy late afternoon with rain threatening, though less than Hershey '85 or SPAC [22]
- Reviewer says the stage was in center field, perhaps slightly toward left, not near home plate [23]
- Venue was a small AAA ballpark of bleachers and cyclone fencing; a friend shut out said the music was audible for blocks [24]
- Reviewer ranks it highly against other 1988 and later shows, as good as this era gets [21]
- It was the smallest venue the reviewer had attended up to then, after JFK, Giants Stadium and Brendan Byrne [24]
- Reviewer is surprised the show is so overlooked [25]
- Show is overlooked because of the strength of summer 1988 tour; first set average, second set strong [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-06-30.akg460.ackerman.andrewf.81533.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Andrew F; source: AKG 460's with CK3 hypercardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5M. Set up FOB, even with the front of the board. [1]. Also: Taped with AKG 460 by Ray; tape flips patched from ShnID-414, discs from Jake Feinberg [1]
- **gd1988-06-30.sbd.miller.96071.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony D5/Dolby B); Set 2: SBD -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [2]. Also: Front-of-board/split source with Schoeps CMC5/MK21 mics to PCM to DAT (shnid 414); Set 2 discs came from David Gans; Joe B. Jones helped with Set 1 pitch correction [2]
- **gd1988-06-30.145661.fob.akg460.ackerman.noel.t-flac16**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Joe Noel; source: Ray Ackerman's Master Audience Cassette Recording & Transfer; AKG 460 w/ck63 caps > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Sony D5 > Master Cassette. Located, front left… [3]. Also: FOB AKG 460 transfer edited in Audacity by Joe Noel; upgrade of shnid 141704, 16 bit 44.1; Set one pauses and tape flips were cross-faded; patch source from John Kemble and Don Crandall [3]
- **gd1988-06-30.144572.FOB.AKG.Kyocera-Remaster.Ackerman.Noel.t-flac2496**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Ray Ackerman and Joe Noel; source: Ray Ackerman's Master Audience Cassette Recording & Transfer; AKG 460 w/ck63 caps > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Sony D5 > Master Cassette. Located, front left… [4]. Also: Kyocera remaster of Noel's FOB AKG transfer, 24-bit/96k release, upgrading shnid 141704; Set one pauses and tape flips were cross-faded; patch source from John Kemble and Don Crandall [4]
- **gd88-06-30.schoeps-fob.gustin.414.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB split Schoeps CMC5/mk21's > PCM > DAT [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @donelichterman: [Grateful Dead Live Jam: Relive the Magic & Gear Up for the IMAX Movie Event! Plus, Tonight's Don's Pick: June 30, 1988, ](https://thegratefuldeadlive.com/grateful-dead-live-jam-relive-the-magic-gear-up-for-the-imax-movie-event-plus-tonights-dons-pick-june-30-1988-silver-stadium/) [30]
